long_biography.plain_text:
Francesco Galli Zugaro built Aqua Expeditions around small-group travel in remote destinations. Before launching the company, he ran a telecoms start-up for a South American private-equity group, then managed sales and marketing for its small-ship investment in the Galápagos.

In Peru, Galli Zugaro shaped Aqua's excursions around close contact between guests and guides, allowing each outing to adapt to the group. The model began on the Amazon and later expanded to the Mekong and other biodiversity-rich regions. As chief executive, he has remained directly involved in developing new destinations and overseeing each launch.

Ponant acquired a majority stake in 2025; he retained a minority shareholding and continues as chief executive. The dossier classifies him as Founder while treating Aqua, its operating assets and external financing as company property rather than direct personal assets.

Galli Zugaro says he was born in Switzerland, AFAR independently calls him Swiss-born and The Peak specifies Zurich.
